## Overview

Describe the problem, your approach, and what you found.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lbs)", y = "Miles per gallon", color = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("thumbnail.png", p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 100)
p
```
